lockFileMaintenance.description: Refresh uv.lock (transitive dependencies) once a week, all of Monday (UTC). The preset default 'before 4am on monday' is never hit: the scheduled workflow runs in the afternoon and starts hours late.

packageRules.description: Digest updates once a week, all of Monday (UTC). The scheduled workflow starts hours late, so a narrow window was never hit.
Raise the >= floors in pyproject.toml along with uv.lock, so the declared minimum follows what is actually tested.
Only move requires-python on a new Python minor; a patch release is no reason to raise the floor.
A Python release bumps .python-version and requires-python in one PR, so the two cannot be merged apart.
